notes.note: Day had plenty of the footy with 26 disposals and he had 7 tackles. But 7 clangers and 37% efficiency hurt him however the wet conditions certainly contributed to that.
Day continues to impress with 27 disposals and 8 clearances this week. He isn't highly owned but as people need to replace injured players he will find his way into more teams.
Will Day presents a huge amount of value at his price with now two over 100 in a row but he won't stay that cheap for long with this level of scoring.

Day looked back to his best this week with 25 disposals and 8 tackles. He is now one that we could certainly look at after his bye. His BE is still high at 86 so if you want him you can wait for one more after his bye.
Good first game back for Day with 18 disposals. Not one to bring in but keep an eye on him.
Day will be missing for much of the season with a shoulder injury.
